Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** a declared layout contract (`fieldGroups[].visibleWhen` false hides the whole group) is broken on the record header. The details body keeps it since objectui#11630. Not an exposure, as the card says: the value is readable through the API either way.
- **For the claimant:** `deriveHighlightFields` reads the same group gate the details body uses. ⛔ Not a second copy of the predicate.

File surface: the record header's derived highlight strip, in `packages/plugin-detail/src/`:
- `synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`: `deriveHighlightFields` (`:442`) and the strip sub-builder (`:627`–`:651`);
- `renderers/record-highlights.tsx`: only if the per-record gate must be evaluated where the record is known;
- `renderers/record-details.tsx`: only to share its existing group gate (`resolveSectionGroup` and the `visibleWhen` evaluation, objectui#11630) with the strip, never to copy it;
- tests beside them;
- one `.changeset/12720-*.md`.

Outside the surface: a DECLARED `highlightFields` entry inside a gated group (the card leaves that to the author), `DetailView.tsx` (objectui#12751), field-level security, and any spec change.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: the derived strip stops showing a member of a group the declared `visibleWhen` hides. If the PR adds a prop to the `record:highlights` node or a package export, the body flips this line to `Clause-②: yes`, which the seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` ACCEPT covers.
Responsibility: n/a — `deriveHighlightFields` predates objectui#11630's group gate, which covered the details body only; no landed PR is named as its cause
Thread-read: 6220494798
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `2dbe5f5`. No open PR names `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, `record-highlights.tsx` or `record-details.tsx` (every open PR's file list was read). objectui#12732 (the same package, `DetailSection.tsx`) has merged.
